experience.description: Leading video editing projects for digital brands and content creators. Responsible for transforming raw footage into engaging visual stories through creative editing, motion graphics, color grading, and sound design.
Worked with creators and small businesses to produce engaging videos for YouTube and social media. Focused on storytelling, smooth transitions, audio synchronization, and visual consistency.
Assisted with video production and post-production tasks, including footage organization, basic editing, audio adjustments, and creating short promotional content for digital platforms.
